name: AI pilot result write-up
summary: When an AI workflow's pilot ends, the pilot owner and the leader who decides get two pages: what was tested and on how many cases, what passed, what failed and why, what nobody tested, the bar set beside the results, and the decision left open. It recommends nothing.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own method for piloting a workflow before the whole team uses it: an acceptance test written before the pilot, a run log kept on real work, a bar the owner states in advance, and a person who decides whether the workflow reaches the team.
